payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, FYI for the test-isolation issue: hv's Mac is clean too. On hv's yes, at 08:21Z I moved the 2830 archives whose roots are all temporary dirs (2824 named utilz-test-*, and 6 from March under /private/tmp/syncz-test, syncz_test_* and xtest) out of ~/Library/Application Support/Unison into ~/.Trash/unison-utilz-test-archives-2026-10-19. Left there: hv's 26 (Google Drive and Dropbox roots), with no archive that does not name /Users/; unison.log was not touched. So a before-and-after count of that dir now starts from hv's 26 alone, which makes a red on main easy to see: one syncz.bats run adds about 18.
